Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1193
Claimant:
Sara Davis
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
June 24, 2023
Claim opened for a left-turn collision at an intersection involving a claimant who reports a concussion. The claimant is
rerpesented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
August 6, 2023
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was active at the time
of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
August 12, 2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene, and spoke with the responding
officer who confirmed the claimant's presence.
September 8, 2023
Scene photographs were received and show some details of the impact, but no independent witnesses have come
forward to describe how the collision happened.
September 18, 2023
Inspected the vehicle damage, which is consistent with the described impact pattern for a left-turn collision. Parts list
and repair estimate were requested from the repair facility.
October 11, 2023
Took a recorded statement from the claimant regarding the crash sequence. The account covered the turn, the point
of impact, and the immediate aftermath.
October 29, 2023
Follow-up call with the claimant's attorney. The account given through counsel matched the claimant's recorded
statement in every detail discussed so far.
November 3, 2023
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is on record, and no prior injury claims
involving the same body area have been identified.
November 10, 2023
Medical records requested. Initial treatment reports desrcibe a concussion, and the care so far appears to be a usual
course for this kind of injury.
December 6, 2023
Reviewed the treatment timeline. Treatment has tapered off as the claimant has improved, though the file does not
yet establish whether the injury came from this crash.
December 10, 2023
Spoke with the treating provider's office to confirm the treatment dates and the current status. Records indicate the
claimant's symptoms have been easing over the recent period.
February 10, 2024
Reserve reviewed and file remains open pending receipt of the complete medical records and the repair estimate.
Causation of the claimed injury is still under evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
